title: Projective morphisms are proper
statement:
Every projective morphism is
proper (the structural
morphism $\mathbf P^N_Y\to Y$ is proper, and closed immersions are
proper; the class of proper morphisms is closed under composition).

proof.text: Let $f:X\to Y$ be projective. By [def-kun-projective] choose $N\geq0$ and a closed immersion $i:X\to\mathbf P^N_Y$ such that $f=q\circ i$, where $q:\mathbf P^N_Y\to Y$ is the structural projection. By [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $\mathbf P^N_Y$ with its structural projection is $\mathbf P(\{0,\ldots,N\};Y)$ with its first projection. Use the finite homogeneous-coordinate set $\{0,\ldots,N\}$ in [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper] with $S=Y$; this gives that $q$ is proper. By clause (a) of [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper], $i$ is proper. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition] to $i$ and $q$ proves that $f$ is proper. The same cited statements give each of the three properness facts in the parenthetical clause of the item.
